name: Instalación de MySQL Workbench y Docker
description: Workbench y MySQL 8.4 en Docker: localhost:33060, contenedor mysql-db. Contraseña inicial de prácticas: secret; configurable en Variables.
content:
- name: Detectar base Ubuntu del equipo
  ansible.builtin.shell: . /etc/os-release; printf "%s" "${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME}"
  register: aula_ubuntu_base
  changed_when: false
- name: Comprobar base Ubuntu compatible
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
    - aula_ubuntu_base.stdout in ['focal', 'jammy', 'noble']
    fail_msg: Se necesita una base Ubuntu focal, jammy o noble identificable en /etc/os-release.
- name: Instalar dependencias y Snap
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name:
    - ca-certificates
    - curl
    - gnome-keyring
    - snapd
    state: present
    update_cache: true
    cache_valid_time: 3600
- name: Habilitar Snap
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: snapd.socket
    state: started
    enabled: true
- name: Consultar Workbench instalado
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - snap
    - list
    - mysql-workbench-community
  register: aula_workbench
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: aula_workbench.rc not in [0, 1]
- name: Instalar MySQL Workbench
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - snap
    - install
    - mysql-workbench-community
  when: aula_workbench.rc == 1
- name: Preparar directorio de claves APT
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /etc/apt/keyrings
    state: directory
    mode: '0755'
- name: Descargar clave oficial de Docker
  ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg
    dest: /etc/apt/keyrings/aula-docker.asc
    mode: '0644'
- name: Registrar repositorio Docker para la base detectada
  ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
    repo: deb [arch={{ 'amd64' if ansible_facts.architecture == 'x86_64' else 'arm64'
      }} signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/aula-docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu
      {{ aula_ubuntu_base.stdout }} stable
    filename: aula-docker
    state: present
- name: Instalar Docker Engine
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name:
    - docker-ce
    - docker-ce-cli
    - containerd.io
    state: present
    update_cache: true
- name: Iniciar Docker
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: docker
    state: started
    enabled: true
- name: Consultar contenedor mysql-db
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - docker
    - container
    - inspect
    - mysql-db
  register: aula_mysql_container
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: aula_mysql_container.rc != 0 and 'No such' not in aula_mysql_container.stderr
  no_log: true
- name: Crear MySQL de prácticas si no existe
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - docker
    - run
    - -d
    - --restart
    - unless-stopped
    - -p
    - 127.0.0.1:33060:3306
    - --name
    - mysql-db
    - -v
    - aula-mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql
    - -e
    - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD={{ aula_mysql_root_password | default('secret') }}
    - mysql:8.4
  when: aula_mysql_container.rc != 0
  no_log: true
- name: Asegurar contenedor MySQL iniciado
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - docker
    - start
    - mysql-db
  changed_when: false
- name: Conectar permisos de Workbench
  ansible.builtin.command:
    argv:
    - snap
    - connect
    - mysql-workbench-community:{{ item }}
  loop:
  - password-manager-service
  - ssh-keys
  changed_when: false

ansible.builtin.assert.fail_msg: Se necesita una base Ubuntu focal, jammy o noble identificable en /etc/os-release.

tasks.name: Registrar repositorio Docker para la base detectada

ansible.builtin.apt_repository.repo: deb [arch={{ 'amd64' if ansible_facts.architecture == 'x86_64' else 'arm64' }} signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/aula-docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu {{ aula_ubuntu_base.stdout }} stable

tasks.name: Consultar contenedor mysql-db
tasks.failed_when: aula_mysql_container.rc != 0 and 'No such' not in aula_mysql_container.stderr

tasks.name: Crear MySQL de prácticas si no existe
